title: Rainbows End
author: Vernor Vinge
summary: Robert Gu, a poet cured of Alzheimer's, finds himself in a near-future world of ubiquitous augmented reality. Retraining as a student, he is drawn into a plot involving mind-control technology.
readIf: you like near-future science fiction about technology and how it reshapes daily life.
skipIf: you want a dense, character-led story with little technical speculation.
